routing_warnings.description: The freelancer's feasibility statement primarily concerns the 50-to-60-second duration constraint rather than changing the exact-script Requirement.
The reported mismatch concerns exact spoken script delivery rather than the visible gameplay demonstration sequence.
The same-phone continuity instruction concerns the phone-message opening staging rather than the gameplay sequence itself.
The concrete failure reported here is a mismatch between the spoken delivery and the supplied text; it does not establish failure of the gameplay actions.
The client reiterates exact script adherence and opening-delivery problems, not a defect in the gameplay demonstration sequence.
The newly added requirement to use the same phone for reading the message and demonstrating the game belongs to the separate same-phone continuity Requirement.
The final complaint primarily concerns poor delivery of the beginning and failure to say everything exactly as scripted, rather than failure to stage the opening with the phone.
